snippet.title: The Button Effect demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

The demo for The Button Effect, by Frycandle, is out now.

The Button Effect in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/the-button-effect/

The Button Effect on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299940/The_Button_Effect/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
